name: iCallify
description_en:
iCallify currently presents itself as a white-label,multi-tenant communications platform sold exclusively to operators such as VoIP providers,MSPs,ITSPs and telecom businesses. Operators deploy it on their servers,cloud accounts or hybrid infrastructure,then provision client tenants and sell contact-centre,unified-communications or hosted-PBX services under their own brand. This is a different buying path from a business subscribing directly to an end-user phone application.

An illustrative operator would connect its SIP carriers,configure branding and tenant permissions,provision a client queue and outbound campaign,and review that client’s usage and records. The operator remains responsible for its customer service and billing model. Public pages describe routing,dialers,recording and integration options,but no deployment,tenant isolation,carrier connection,campaign,invoice or export was tested.
description_zh:
iCallify当前定位为白标、多租户通信平台，FAQ称仅销售给VoIP服务商、MSP、ITSP及电信企业等运营方。运营方在自有服务器、云账户或混合基础设施部署，再创建客户租户，以自有品牌销售联络中心、统一通信或托管PBX服务。这不同于企业直接订阅终端电话应用的购买路径。

假设运营方会连接SIP运营商、配置品牌和租户权限、开通客户队列及外呼活动，再复核客户用量和记录。客户服务及计费模式仍由运营方负责。公开页面描述路由、拨号器、录音及集成选项，但未测试部署、租户隔离、运营商连接、活动、发票或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Provision client environments with separate users,flows,reports,domains and optional tenant branding.
core_features.explanation_zh: 创建分开用户、流程、报表、域名及可选品牌的客户环境。

core_features.explanation_en: Use skill/priority/time-based ACD,multilevel IVR,sticky agents and per-tenant recording policies.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用技能／优先／时段ACD、多层IVR、固定客服及按租户录音策略。

core_features.explanation_en: Select preview,progressive or predictive behavior and maintain campaign lists from call outcomes.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择预览、渐进或预测行为，并按电话结果管理活动名单。

core_features.explanation_en: Application-layer deployment is described as retaining operator SIP trunks and carrier relationships.
core_features.explanation_zh: 应用层部署描述可保留运营方SIP线路及运营商关系。

en: A VoIP provider adding branded contact-centre services to its existing carrier and PBX portfolio.
An MSP operating separate client environments with centralized provisioning and per-client reporting.
zh: 在既有运营商及PBX产品上增加自有品牌联络中心服务的VoIP服务商。
集中开通、按客户报表并运营独立客户环境的MSP。
use_cases.basis: Editorial fit,not verified margin,ARPU or migration outcomes.

Infrastructure ownership.en: Vendor deploys on operator servers,cloud account or hybrid infrastructure. Shared-platform tenant isolation does not establish dedicated infrastructure or unrestricted source-code rights.
Infrastructure ownership.zh: 厂商在运营方服务器、云账户或混合基础设施部署；共享平台租户隔离不建立独立基础设施或无限制源码权。

specific_roles: Client onboarding and carrier integration owner

steps.en: Confirm operator eligibility,products,tenant/call capacity,carrier connections,branding and actual license/add-on scope.
steps.zh: 确认运营方资格、产品、租户／电话容量、运营商连接、品牌及真实许可／附加范围。

steps.en: Deploy one pilot tenant with roles,number routing,IVR,agent access and disposition rules before migrating client traffic.
steps.zh: 迁客户流量前部署一个试点租户，配置角色、号码路由、IVR、客服访问及处置规则。

steps.en: Test cross-tenant access,failed/no-agent calls,CRM writes,usage reconciliation and exit export using the selected contract.
steps.zh: 按所选合同测试跨租户访问、失败／无客服电话、CRM写入、用量对账及退出导出。

items.en: Current homepage explicitly excludes direct end-user sales;businesses may need an operator rather than direct self-service purchase.
items.zh: 当前主页明确不直接卖给终端用户，企业可能需经运营方而非直接自助购买。

items.en: CRM and digital channels are also listed as add-ons despite broad omnichannel headlines;actual entitlement must be scoped.
items.zh: 虽有全渠道标题，CRM及数字渠道也列为附加项，需定义真实权益。

items.en: Power dialer pages mix one-call-per-agent language with dialing-ratio controls;exact pacing,wrap-up and no-agent handling remain unverified.
items.zh: Power页将每客服一通与拨号比例控制并列，真实节奏、整理时间及无客服处理未核。

items.en: Zero disruption,higher margins,unlimited clients and tenant isolation are vendor claims rather than executed migration,load or security evidence.
items.zh: 零中断、更高利润、无限客户及租户隔离是厂商主张，未执行迁移、负载或安全验证。

items.en: Website terms do not establish operator license,renewal,refund,termination or complete record-export rights.
items.zh: 网站条款不建立运营方许可、续约、退款、终止或完整记录导出权。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 主页确认仅面向运营方许可部署，定制开发按固定成本、小时或专属人员计。联络中心页明确列CRM、WhatsApp、SMS／MMS及邮件附加项。未建立公开固定金额、币种、许可单位、最低量、续费、试用期或完整运营商／基础设施／支持成本。免费开始／演示按钮不建立持续免费运行。

faq.question_en: Can an ordinary company buy it directly for its agents?
faq.question_zh: 普通企业能直接为客服购买吗？
faq.answer_en: The current homepage says sales are exclusively to operators and directs end-user businesses toward their provider or MSP. Older feature pages addressing businesses do not override that stated current buying model.
faq.answer_zh: 当前主页称仅向运营方销售，终端企业应联系服务商或MSP。旧功能页面对企业的描述不能覆盖当前明确购买模式。

faq.question_en: Does own-infrastructure deployment establish source-code ownership?
faq.question_zh: 自有基础设施部署就拥有源码吗？
faq.answer_en: No such right was established. Hosting control,white-label branding and product licensing are separate;the actual operator agreement was not reviewed.
faq.answer_zh: 未建立这种权利。托管控制、白标品牌及产品许可不同，未读真实运营方协议。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: The buyer is the communications operator
sections.en:
The current homepage explicitly says iCallify sells exclusively to VoIP providers,MSPs,ITSPs and telecom operators,not directly to businesses using the contact centre. The operator licenses the platform,deploys it under its brand and sells services to client tenants. CCaaS,UCaaS and IP PBX are described as product lines on that platform. A company seeking only a few agent accounts needs to establish which provider will serve it rather than assuming a direct SaaS checkout.

This distinction changes ownership of the work:the operator chooses commercial bundles,client support and billing;the client’s agents handle calls and digital interactions. Website comparisons with rival vendors and promises of better margins were not independently checked,and no alternative relationship is approved by this research.
sections.zh:
当前主页明确iCallify仅向VoIP服务商、MSP、ITSP及电信运营方销售，不直接卖给使用联络中心的企业。运营方许可平台，以自有品牌部署并向客户租户销售服务，CCaaS、UCaaS及IP PBX是其产品线。只需少量客服账号的企业，应先确定由哪个服务商提供，而非假设可直接SaaS结账。

这改变工作责任：运营方决定商业组合、客户支持及计费，客户客服负责电话及数字互动。网站竞品对照和更高利润承诺未经独立核查，本次研究不批准任何替代关系。

sections.title_en: Pilot a tenant on the operator’s own voice stack
sections.title_zh: 在运营方既有语音体系试跑一个租户
sections.en:
iCallify describes deployment on operator servers,cloud accounts or hybrid infrastructure,connecting existing SIP trunks,carriers and softswitches. From an operator dashboard,the provider creates client environments with separate users,flows,reports and branding. Tenant domains,logos,colours and email templates can be configured. Shared-platform isolation is an access-control claim;it does not imply a physically dedicated server per client.

An illustrative onboarding pilot should prove one number route,agent login,IVR path,recording policy and tenant report before client traffic moves. Test cross-tenant search,recording links,administrator access and load contention. The vendor estimates two to six weeks to first client onboarding and advertises disruption-free migration;neither is a guaranteed schedule or an executed number-portability test here.
sections.zh:
iCallify描述在运营方服务器、云账户或混合设施部署，连接既有SIP线路、运营商及软交换。运营方通过后台创建分开用户、流程、报表及品牌的客户环境，可配置租户域名、标志、颜色及邮件模板。共享平台隔离是访问控制主张，不代表每客户独立物理服务器。

假设开通试点需在迁流量前验证一条号码路由、客服登录、IVR路径、录音策略及租户报表，并测试跨租户查询、录音链接、管理员访问和负载争用。厂商估计首次客户上线两至六周并宣传无中断迁移，这不是本档案保证进度或已执行号码迁移验证。

sections.title_en: Check when the next call starts and what outcome persists
sections.title_zh: 核对下一通何时发起及结果如何保存
sections.en:
Contact-centre documentation distinguishes predictive pacing based on agent availability,progressive dialing only when an agent is free,and preview context before connecting. Dispositions support campaign-list management. Skills,priority,time-of-day routes and sticky agents affect inbound assignment,while supervisors monitor queues and calls. A completed phone connection should still be checked against the saved campaign outcome and intended CRM record.

The Power Dialer page describes sequential dialing immediately after hangup and one call per available agent,but also exposes dialing-ratio controls and wording about not waiting for availability. Exact wrap-up behavior,ratio semantics,retries and no-agent handling are unresolved. Claims of perfect AMD,no dropped calls or fivefold campaign speed are not verified guarantees. Test machine/busy/no-answer outcomes and a full queue before choosing an aggressive pace.
sections.zh:
联络中心资料区分按客服可用情况预测节奏、客服空闲才渐进拨号，以及接通前预览上下文，处置结果用于活动名单管理。技能、优先级、时段路由及固定客服影响呼入分配，主管监控队列及电话。电话接通后还需比对保存的活动结果及目标CRM记录。

Power页描述挂断后立即顺序拨号、每个可用客服一通，却也列拨号比例控制及不等可用状态的措辞。真实整理时间、比例语义、重试及无客服处理未解决。完美AMD、零掉线及五倍速度未经验证，应先测试答录机、忙线、无人接及满队列，再选择高强度节奏。

sections.title_en: A channel on the platform is not automatically a paid entitlement
sections.title_zh: 平台上的渠道不自动等于已付权益
sections.en:
The contact-centre page advertises a unified agent desktop for voice,chat,email,SMS,WhatsApp and social channels,but its Add-on Features section separately lists CRM integration,WhatsApp,SMS/MMS and email. CRM synchronization and screen pops therefore need a contract and connector scope rather than being inferred from an omnichannel headline. The reviewed pages do not establish field-level permissions,duplicate resolution,retry guarantees or historical backfill.

For an illustrative support case,define where customer identity lives,which tenant may access it,and whether a disposition opens a ticket or merely logs a call. Likewise,central usage reporting and billing status do not prove complete invoices,tax calculation,payment collection or reconciliation. CCaaS customer interactions,UCaaS collaboration and PBX extensions remain different operational scopes even when offered by one platform.
sections.zh:
联络中心页宣传语音、聊天、邮件、短信、WhatsApp及社交统一桌面，但Add-on Features另列CRM集成、WhatsApp、SMS／MMS及邮件。因此CRM同步和弹屏需核对合同及连接器范围，不能由全渠道标题推断。已读页面不建立字段权限、重复记录处理、重试保证或历史回填。

假设支持案例需定义客户身份存何处、哪个租户可访问，以及处置是开工单还是仅记电话。同样，集中用量报表及计费状态不证明完整发票、税额、收款或对账。即使同平台提供，CCaaS客户互动、UCaaS协作及PBX分机仍是不同运营范围。

sections.title_en: Commercial conditions are known;the actual license price is not
sections.title_zh: 已知部分商业条件，真实许可价仍未知
sections.en:
The homepage confirms operator licensing and offers custom development on fixed-cost,hourly or dedicated-resource terms. These are real commercial distinctions,but no reviewed page establishes a fixed platform amount,currency,license unit,minimum term or complete deployment/carrier/support cost. The operator sets its downstream prices;that does not establish the vendor’s own license calculation or a guaranteed margin. Demo and Get Started for Free buttons do not prove a sustained free platform or a specified trial.

The published Terms of Use govern website content and links,not the actual operator software agreement. Source-code rights,renewal,cancellation,refunds,tenant migration,data retention and complete exit exports remain unknown. iCallify is an editorial fit for a provider able to own infrastructure,carrier relationships and client onboarding. A verified direct end-user subscription,zero-maintenance hosting and a guaranteed portable archive were not established.
sections.zh:
主页确认运营方许可，并提供固定成本、按小时或专属人员定制开发。这些是真实商业区别，但已读页面未建立固定平台金额、币种、许可单位、最低期限或完整部署／运营商／支持成本。运营方自定下游价格不建立厂商许可计算或保证利润；演示及免费开始按钮不证明持续免费平台或具体试用。

公开使用条款管网站内容和链接，不是真实运营方软件协议。源码权、续约、取消、退款、租户迁移、留存及完整退出导出仍未知。编辑判断适合能负责基础设施、运营商关系及客户开通的服务商，尚未建立已核终端企业直购、零维护托管及保证可携档案。

research_gaps.zh: 未测试部署、运营商、活动、租户安全、AI、CRM、发票、导出或负载。真实许可金额／单位／周期、附加包含、试用、源码／退出权、留存、删除、完整导出、SLA、界面语言、Power比例／整理时间、重试及身份匹配未知。保留当前仅运营方FAQ，旧终端功能描述不覆盖；厂商案例／利润／零中断非独立证据。
